Apartament 3+1 ne Shitje tek Brryli
Shitet Apartament 2+1 (i konvertuar ne 3+1) tek Brryli, prane Shkolles Niket Dardani.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e dyte te nje pallati te ri te mireadministruar me ashensor ne nje zone qe ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme.
Organizohet nga korridori shperndares i ambienteve, sonxhorno bashke me kendin e gatimit, tre dhoma gjumi, tualeti dhe veranda spacioze.
Apartamenti eshte pjese e nje pallati te ri te sapoperfunduar me punime teper cilesore dhe bashkekohore, fasade te ventiluar, kondicionim multisplit etj.
Prona eshte ne proces hipotekimi.

description_en: 3+1 apartment for sale in Brryli 2+1 apartment (converted to 3+1) for sale in Brryli, near Niket Dardani School. The apartment is located on the second floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator in an area that offers all the necessary facilities. It is organized by the distribution corridor of the premises, a living room with a kitchenette, three bedrooms, a bathroom and a spacious veranda. The apartment is part of a new building that has just been completed with high-quality and contemporary works, ventilated facade, multisplit air conditioning, etc. The property is in the mortgage process.
